## Invitations

A total of 1816 invitations were issued during the outreach activity. Attendance was recorded at 965 people, representing a rate of 53.1 per cent. These figures provide a summary of invitations issued and participation during the reporting period. The attendance information will support routine review of the outreach response and help inform ongoing contact with people who did not attend.

## Contact

SMS contact was recorded for 0 invitees. Reminders were also recorded at 0. Staff continue to contact people by phone where appointments were missed. This ongoing approach supports engagement with people who may require further assistance or information about accessing the service.
